title: AccessContextResponse
description: The calling user's effective permissions in one organization. Membership is implied by the response itself: a non-member never gets a body, the tenant-resolution middleware answers 404 first, so 200 always means 'member'. Consumed by services that don't own Membership/UserRole/RolePermission directly (see docs/decisions/0016-devices-service-owns-its-own-database.md).
